q_hi:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Garner
solution:
The word 'Garner' means to gather or collect something, especially information or approval. Among the options, 'Collect' is the most accurate synonym. 'Send' and 'Distribute' are unrelated or opposite in meaning.

'Garner' का अर्थ है इकट्ठा करना या संचित करना (to collect or gather)। दिए गए विकल्पों में 'Collect' इसका सबसे सटीक पर्यायवाची है। 'Send' (भेजना) और 'Distribute' (वितरण करना) इसके विपरीत अर्थ रखते हैं।

Short Trick: Garner = Gather = Collect. Remember 'G' for Gather.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Applaud
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Applaud
solution:
The word 'Applaud' means to show approval or praise. Its antonym (opposite) is 'Censure', which means to express severe disapproval or criticism. 'Progress' means to move forward, and 'Recede' means to move back.

'Applaud' का अर्थ है प्रशंसा करना या सराहना करना। इसका विलोम (Antonym) 'Censure' है, जिसका अर्थ है कड़ी निंदा करना या आलोचना करना। 'Progress' (प्रगति) और 'Recede' (पीछे हटना) इसके संदर्भ में सही नहीं हैं।

Short Trick: Applaud (Praise) vs Censure (Criticize).

q_en:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

She was just going to take a cigarette off the mentalpiece when the girl said quickly, but so lightly and strangely that she was sorry.325
q_hi:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

She was just going to take a cigarette off the mentalpiece when the girl said quickly, but so lightly and strangely that she was sorry.325
solution:
In the sentence, the word 'mentalpiece' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'mantelpiece', which refers to the shelf above a fireplace. The words strangely, sorry, and cigarette are spelled correctly.

वाक्य में 'mentalpiece' शब्द गलत है। सही शब्द 'mantelpiece' (M-A-N-T-E-L-P-I-E-C-E) है, जो अंगीठी के ऊपर की शेल्फ को कहते हैं। अन्य शब्द 'strangely', 'sorry' और 'cigarette' की स्पेलिंग सही है।

Short Trick: Mantel (shelf) vs Mental (mind).

q_en: What is the meaning of 'To be under the weather'?229
q_hi: What is the meaning of 'To be under the weather'?229
solution:
The idiom 'under the weather' is used when someone feels sick or unwell, usually with a minor illness like a cold or headache. It does not mean being angry, tired, or happy.

मुहावरा 'under the weather' तब इस्तेमाल किया जाता है जब कोई व्यक्ति बीमार या अस्वस्थ (unwell) महसूस करता है। इसका प्रयोग अक्सर मामूली बीमारियों जैसे सर्दी या सिरदर्द के लिए होता है।

Short Trick: Under the weather = Feeling sick.

'Looking down on' एक वाक्यांश (phrase) है जिसका अर्थ है ऊपर से नीचे की ओर देखना। यहाँ सौर मंडल को सूर्य के उत्तरी ध्रुव से देखने के संदर्भ में 'on' सबसे उपयुक्त है।

Short Trick: Look down on = View from above.

solution:
The words 'counter-clockwise' and 'clockwise' describe the path or 'direction' of rotation. Therefore, 'direction' is the most logical word to complete the phrase. 'Pattern' or 'speed' do not specifically define clockwise movement.

'Counter-clockwise' और 'clockwise' घूमने की 'दिशा' (direction) को दर्शाते हैं। इसलिए यहाँ 'direction' सबसे सटीक शब्द है।

Short Trick: Clockwise/Counter-clockwise = Direction.

Its day is very long—243 Earth days—which is even (3)_____ than its year—225 Earth days. It’s an (4)_____ question as to why Venus spins the other way. Solar tides acting on Venus’s very dense atmosphere or (5)_____ with large bodies are suspected.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The sentence compares the length of Venus's day (243 days) with its year (225 days). When comparing two things, we use the comparative degree. 'Longer' followed by 'than' is the grammatically correct form.

यहाँ शुक्र (Venus) के दिन और वर्ष की तुलना की जा रही है। दो चीजों की तुलना के लिए 'Comparative Degree' (-er form) का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'longer' सही है।

Short Trick: Comparison between two = -er + than.

Solar tides acting on Venus’s very dense atmosphere or (5)_____ with large bodies are suspected.

solution:
The phrase 'an open question' refers to a matter that is not yet decided or where the answer is unknown. It fits the context of why Venus rotates differently, as scientists are still debating the cause. 'Avid' or 'eager' usually describe people.

'An open question' एक मुहावरा है जिसका अर्थ है ऐसा विषय जिस पर अभी भी बहस जारी हो या जिसका उत्तर स्पष्ट न हो। शुक्र के उलटा घूमने का कारण अभी भी शोध का विषय है, इसलिए 'open' सही है।

Short Trick: Open question = Unsolved mystery.

Its day is very long—243 Earth days—which is even (3)_____ than its year—225 Earth days. It’s an (4)_____ question as to why Venus spins the other way. Solar tides acting on Venus’s very dense atmosphere or (5)_____ with large bodies are suspected.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
In astronomy, the unusual rotation of a planet is often attributed to 'collisions' with large celestial bodies (like asteroids or protoplanets) during its early history. 'Formations' or 'meetups' do not imply the physical impact needed to change rotation.

खगोल विज्ञान में, ग्रहों के घूमने की दिशा बदलने का एक प्रमुख कारण बड़े पिंडों के साथ 'टक्कर' या 'collisions' माना जाता है। 'Meetups' (मिलना) या 'formations' (संरचना) यहाँ फिट नहीं बैठते।

Short Trick: Space impact = Collision.
